items.h: Tyler Bass scores 15 points in win Sunday
items.s: Tyler Bass went 4-for-4 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders. Bass played quite well on Sunday. He made all seven of his kicks and was responsible for 15 of Buffalo's points on the afternoon, which made a big impact in a game that they won by just three points. He will continue to be a good option at the kicker position for the foreseeable future.

items.h: Tyler Bass a Strong Kicking Option Against the Raiders
items.s: Buffalo Bills kicker Tyler Bass has converted all nine of his field-goal attempts this season, including three during Monday's overtime victory against the Rams. His final attempt, a 45-yarder, secured Buffalo's 37-34 victory and capped an 11-point performance. Bass has benefited from an offense that has scored at least 24 points in every game this season, providing him with consistent scoring opportunities. The Bills now face a Las Vegas defense that has allowed 102 points over its last three contests, including 45 against New England in Week 5. items.h: Tyler Bass wins it in OT for Bills in Week 5
items.s: Tyler Bass made all three of his field-goal attempts and hit two of his three extra points in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5. Bass hit field goals from 49, 23, and 45 yards out in the win. His 45-yard attempt won the game for the Bills with two minutes left in overtime. Bass has now hit all 10 of his field-goal attempts this season. He will take on the Raiders in Week 6.

items.h: Tyler Bass Remains a Viable Week 5 Kicker
items.s: Buffalo Bills kicker Tyler Bass has made all six of his field-goal attempts through four games, but the opportunities haven't exactly been plentiful. Three of those attempts came in the season opener, and he's attempted only three field goals over the last three weeks. Bass connected from 27 and 38 yards against New England, his first multi-field-goal game since Week 1. Buffalo now faces a Rams defense that has allowed just 582 passing yards, while Joshua Palmer is out and DJ Moore remains questionable. Bass made multiple field goals in a contest for the first time since Week 1, converting a 27-yard attempt in the second quarter before adding a 38-yarder in the fourth quarter. The kicker has yet to attempt a kick from 50-plus yards this season, but he has has gone a perfect 6-for-6 on field-goal tries over the first four contests of the year.

items.h: Tyler Bass More of a Streaming Choice in Week 4
items.s: Buffalo Bills kicker Tyler Bass has made all four of his field-goal attempts this season and 11 of 12 extra points, but the Bills' ability to finish drives has limited his field-goal volume. Buffalo is averaging 33.7 points per game, so there will almost always be scoring opportunities attached to this offense. The question is how many come in threes instead of sevens. items.h: Makes all four kicks vs. Bolts
items.s: Bass made his lone field-goal attempt and all three of his extra-point tries during Sunday's 24-16 win over the Chargers. The Bills finally got on the scoreboard at the 6:02 mark of the second quarter on a 28-yard, chip-shot field goal by Bass, with the veteran kicker making each of his next three extra-point attempts. He's made all four of his field-goal attempts (all within 50 yards) and has gone 11-for-12 on extra-point tries through three regular-season games, and his scoring floor should be elevated week-to-week as long as Josh Allen is running the Bills' offense. Buffalo wraps up its three-game home stand in a Week 4 AFC East showdown against New England.

Tyler Bass converted his only field goal attempt as well as all three of his extra point attempts to finish with six points in the Bills' 24-16 win over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 3. Bass has offered modest output to begin the season, recording five or more points in each of the first three contests. The kicker benefits from playing behind one of the more high-powered offenses on a regular basis, with a Week 4 contest against the New England Patriots up next.
